phrases.latin: Hīc sumus nōs: haec est Bulgaria; hīc Serdica, urbs magna; hīc, prope Serdicam, sub monte, Osoitsa, vīcus noster.
phrases.english: Here we are: this is Bulgaria; here is Sofia, a big city; here, near Sofia, below the mountain, Osoitsa, our village.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
